text: In the Indonesian countryside in 1981, a family sinks into debt after Mawarni, a former singer, dies of a long illness. Soon [her pale shape walks the house at night|threat|the restless dead], the grandmother is found dead in the well, and an occult writer tells the eldest daughter Rini about [a fertility cult that answered barren women's prayers|wrong|bargains with dark powers]. Its price was the last child, and [six-year-old Ian, who is deaf|who_suffers|young children], turns seven in three days as the cult gathers around the house in a storm to [mark it for the dead|ending|taken to the other side].
